explanation: A government already in office won the absolute majority of 1987. It was twenty-one months old, and a censure motion had brought it down, which the voters were then asked to judge. This election put that government there and made it a minority. Four parties sat in the Assembly, and a fifth, the PRD, held enough seats to deny anyone a majority. The atlas argues the sequence and does not say the outcome was bound to happen. Without a minority Cavaco government there is no censure motion, and without the censure motion there is no election in July 1987 for a majority to be won at.
